name: Wei and Jin Dynasties
summary: Art flourished in the Wei and Jin dynasties (220–420 CE) across China’s Central Plains and Jiangnan regions amid national political fragmentation and the rise of Xuanxue (Neo-Taoism) metaphysical thought.
